member_faq_1_q: How is this different from the ¥19.9 single unlock?
member_faq_1_a: A single unlock covers one report permanently; the monthly card unlocks all reports during the period. Unlocking three reports inside one period ≈ three permanent unlocks — effectively 50% off.
member_faq_2_q: Do my reports disappear after expiry?
member_faq_2_a: No. Reports unlocked during the period are kept permanently; only the aggregate value pages re-lock when the membership ends.
member_faq_3_a: No. Only the monthly card exists this season — no quarterly or yearly cards, no auto-renewal.
member_faq_4_a: Digital content counts as delivered once provided; refunds are not supported by default — exceptions are handled offline.
member_faq_5_a: No. Age is judged precisely by birth year and month; anyone under 18 is blocked from paying.
